fusions.name: Foragers Out
fusions.desc: Sends 3 foragers out from the hive in your shell in a spread out to 6 tiles; each one deals 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb Left Behind
fusions.desc: Fires a barbed sting that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and stays in the wound, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Open Comb
fusions.desc: Opens a honeycomb field within 3 tiles of where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. For 7 seconds a swarm fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Colony Aboard
fusions.desc: A bonded swarm fights beside you, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 2 health.
